itemList.description: Dismentling of 75HP induction Burnt Motor by removing of end shield, motor de breezing of connections removing of slots wedges cleaning the stator properly using suitable solvents, dismentiling of coils from the stator by removal of wadges and spacers carefully without damaging the slots removal of connections after trseing out connection properly data retravel removal of over hang lacing debris of connection joint removal coils from the stator slots without damaging the slots formation of new coils by using 99.9 percentage pure electrolites grade copper enamelled wire double glass covered with LT grade class F insulation shaping of coils by using exclusive fixtures maintaining the pitch and noise shape as per original specification. Application of anticurressive shield on the core portion of the coil conduct electrical test, machenical cleaning of the pocket conduct the hot spot test if hot spot or found removal of the stampings, revarnished dr.beck 65E R becking varnish restacak the core pocket and lock it under pressure of stator restaging including men and materials

The new coil shall be tested for 4 KVA Ac current in slot portion for one minute the test to be a same at tapping of coils in core portion with semi thermo class 'F' insulation of each moulded coils as per the original specification by using exclusive fixtures and jigs maintaining the pin distance which and nose X shape as per specification insulating the over hanging position etc complete

Insertation of paramoulded coil into stator by providing graphite sheet or spaying with conducting varnish on core position of coils bottom layer of coils seperator wadges species sigments should be providedly suitably epoxy bounded laminate is to be used for class 'F' grade providing and connection as per original specification. Using 14 percentage  silver breezing alloy rods high voltage testing before the series connection of the winding as per IS specification and applying of gel coat epoxy by sparying to complete stator winding etc complete including men and materials

Rewinding resistance shall be measured for all three phases and difference shall not exceed 2percentage  surge compression test at rated voltage on the three phases should be done. Measurement of insulation resistance and ten delta test at rated voltage should be carriedout including ovening for 12 Hrs at 1200 C temperature over hang portion of the stator winding etc complete including men and materials
Supply and fixing of brand New Bearing DE bearing SKF Make Made in Germany Rooler Explor No NU314 C3
Supply and fixing of brand New Bearing NDE bearing No6311 E3 N Series SKF Make

Loading and unloading from site to workshop and workshop to work site transportation, lead and lift charges such as 70 HP Motor repairable parts bowl assembly, lead and lift to the jackwell to ground level to near approach road by the help of hydra crane loading to the 10 metric ton capacity mini truck transportation to the Hubballi work shop and workshop to Arendur jackwell including unloading etc complete
